rows.text: The Élysée states that 'M. François Hollande a accueilli au Palais de l'Élysée, à 10 heures le dimanche 14 mai 2017, M. Emmanuel Macron, élu le 7 mai 2017 Président de la République', and that after a meeting of nearly an hour M. Emmanuel Macron accompanied him to his car.

rows.text: It states that he then went to the Salon des ambassadeurs, where he received the insignia of Grand Master of the Legion of Honour, and entered the Salle des Fêtes, where the President of the Constitutional Council, Laurent Fabius, proclaimed the official results of the presidential election.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-23 only (Président de la République, 1 January 1990 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff).
